    Indian · Sides

    Raita

    A cooling yoghurt and mint side with ginger and garam masala for warmth. We serve it with Moh's Duck Curry.

    Serves
    6
    recipe says 6–8
    Prep10 min
    VegetarianUnder 30 min

    Ingredients

    Amounts with a number are scaled and rounded. Amounts in the method, and things like "to taste" or "a handful", stay as written.

    • 250 g (1 cup) Greek yoghurt
    • 1 garlic clove
    • Thumb-sized piece ginger, finely grated
    • ¼ small pack (UK size) mint, leaves chopped
    • Juice of ½ lime
    • ½ tsp garam masala, plus a little extra to serve
    • ¼ cucumber, grated and lightly squeezed

    Tick things off as you go. Tap an ingredient's name to see where it's used.

    Method

    1. Mix all the ingredients together and season.
    2. Serve sprinkled with extra garam masala.

    From our kitchen

    How we make it

    1. 28 Oct 2026

      Left out the coriander (½ small pack, chopped, in the original). We make it without.
